capabilities: Provide a university home dashboard and class capture workflow
Manage daily notes and a course folder structure per semester
Maintain a read-only timetable and a reminders table
Show a month/week agenda with toggleable layers for timetable, local events, and feeds
Import ICS feeds such as Google Calendar with manual or periodic sync
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not a unique-note generator; it is a full university workspace with agenda, timetable, and reminders.
extras: README is mostly Spanish with a short English section. Requires Obsidian 1.11.5+ for ICS features. Warns not to run it alongside the separate unique and unique-agenda plugins. ICS secrets are stored per device in Obsidian SecretStorage; automatic deletion of absent ICS events is suspended to avoid deleting valid notes. Includes MIT-licensed code from Obsidian Calendar (see NOTICE).
intentEvidence: no lo instales junto a los plugins separados unique y unique-agenda
motivation: The author bundled the system he uses daily as a student so classes, journal, timetable, reminders, and calendar work in one install instead of three plugins.
problem: Setting up an organized university vault normally means installing and configuring several separate plugins for daily notes, timetables, reminders, and calendars.
